attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) with nftables `dup` mirroring rules that clone IP traffic exchanged between node1 (10.100.189.10) and node2 (10.100.189.11) onto eth0 addressed toward node3 (10.100.189.12). node3's tcpdump now captures the original packets (still addressed to node1/node2, not to node3) while the real node1<->node2 traffic keeps flowing unmodified. Rules persisted in /etc/nftables.conf with nftables.service enabled to survive reboot. Completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol for node1, node2, and node3, confirming a changed boot_id/uptime on each and re-verifying mirroring plus connectivity after every restart.
